chat_group_simulation_desc: 30/60/90 days balance forecasting, purchase budget impact simulation, loan amortization calculation, and saving recommendations.

chat_info_assistant_desc: The OmniBank assistant is a local AI connected to your financial database. It can check your accounts, analyze spending, forecast balances and help optimize your budget. Ask questions in plain language, and it will automatically choose the right tools to answer accurately.
chat_info_desc_general: OmniBank Local AI uses your local Ollama instance to analyze your finances confidentially (no data leaves your computer).
chat_info_role_advisor: 💬 Advisor: General overview, answers to your questions.
chat_info_role_simulator: 📐 Simulator: Projects and impacts on your savings.
chat_info_supervision_desc: For every anomaly detected, category conflict suggestion, or transaction correction, the assistant displays an interactive review button. You keep full control: no changes are applied to your database without your explicit validation.
chat_info_tool_similar_spends: 📅 search_similar_past_spends: Compare seasonal spends to last year.
chat_info_tool_summary: 🔍 get_financial_summary: Current Left to Live & next paycheck.
chat_info_tools_desc: The AI decides to call these tools automatically depending on your question:
chat_info_tools_intro: The AI automatically selects the right tools based on your question:
chat_info_validation_desc: When the AI proposes to modify a transaction in your database (category, description, amount...), it can never do so without your explicit approval. A validation box appears with the proposed changes: you can review, accept or reject each modification before it is applied.
chat_intro: The assistant automatically has access to your financial data and daily statistics.
chat_modal_ai_desc_generic: The AI proposes to execute the following action. Please review the changes before validating.
chat_report_advisor: Give me a comprehensive financial report of my current situation. What are my strengths and areas to watch?
chat_report_alerts: Give me a detailed report of anomalies, recent excessive spending, and urgent overdraft risks.
chat_report_auditor: Search for inconsistencies in my transactions: categorization errors, suspicious amounts, or forgotten reconciliations.
chat_report_budget_planner: Compare my actual spending to defined budget envelopes. Recommend realistic adjustments for next month.
chat_report_forecaster: Project my accounts balance over the next 3 months considering my planned recurring transactions and spending history.
chat_report_optimizer: Identify my subscriptions and recurring expenses. Are there optimization opportunities or potential duplicates?
chat_report_simulator: Analyze my savings capacity and current financial flexibility for new projects or purchases.
config_ai_ctx_hint: Minimum 8192 (8K) recommended for tool-enabled Chat (to prevent early history loss), and 32K required for large imports.
config_ai_ctx_hint_detail: A context size of 16384 (16K) or more is highly recommended to fit all tool descriptions and chat history. Note: changing these settings forces Ollama to reload the model, causing a delay on the first query.

maintenance_convert_zeroed_action_desc: By checking these transactions ({count} detected), they will be converted into properly 'Skipped' occurrences (passed/paused). Their amount will be restored to its original value (shown by the → arrow). This allows your recurrence to stay active and keep generating the following months at their normal amount.
maintenance_convert_zeroed_desc_1: Previously, to temporarily pause a subscription or recurrence (e.g. Audible paused for 3 months), the only solution was to manually set the occurrence amount to 0.00 €.
maintenance_convert_zeroed_desc_2: However, these 0 € amounts mislead the maintenance algorithms into believing the recurrence has been permanently closed or abandoned, triggering auto-closures or false orphan detections.
maintenance_convert_zeroed_none: No transactions to convert. Everything is in order!

maintenance_orphan_none: No orphan recurrences detected. Everything is in order!

maintenance_orphan_warning: Checked transactions will be permanently deleted. Reconciled transactions can never be deleted.
